claim: disrobe re-hosts Dalvik method bodies into class bytecode that the real JVM bytecode verifier accepts under -Xverify:all, on the committed dex corpus.
detail: 102 of 103 verifiable classes pass the real JVM bytecode verifier (-Xverify:all) on the committed EdgeCases/EdgeCasesKt/Hello dex; 0 lifter verify failures (the 103rd is link-blocked by an unbundled Kotlin Function1 supertype, a test-harness limit not a lifter defect); a live-range-splitting pass recovers bodies with conflicting register types across joins, 307 re-hosted method bodies verify clean; floor 102 classes; oracle is the JVM rejecting malformed bytecode, not the lifter self-report
gate_source: crates/disrobe-pass-jvm/tests/dalvik_verifier_gate.rs (VERIFY_CLEAN_CLASS_FLOOR 102, LIFTER_VERIFY_FAIL_CEILING 0, BODY_VERIFY_CLEAN_FLOOR 307); oracle = -Xverify:all over assemble_jar output, not the lifter self-report; measured 102/103 classes + 307 re-hosted bodies on JDK 25

oracle.external: real JVM verifier (-Xverify:all over the assembled jar; the JVM rejects malformed bytecode)

title: Dalvik recovered bodies, real JVM verifier
